title: clinopodium domingense
intro: Clinopodium domingense, commonly known as Puerto Rican wild basil, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health issues such as digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium domingense include its analgesic, expectorant, and antiseptic effects, which help in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and promoting the healing of wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
